summary: Integrate Husky and lint-staged with existing repository checks while preserving scripts, staged work, and usable commit latency.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.reason: Merge hooks, prepare scripts, formatting rules, and workspace conventions instead of initializing over them.
deltas.tradeoff: Installation needs a small repository inspection.

deltas.reason: Read packageManager metadata and lockfiles, resolving conflicts instead of defaulting blindly to npm.
deltas.tradeoff: An ambiguous repository may need a targeted clarification.

deltas.reason: Choose noninteractive useful checks and account for slow or external suites while preserving required CI coverage.
deltas.tradeoff: The hook may not run the source entire default suite.

deltas.reason: Use isolated fixtures for formatting, blocking failures, clean runs, and partial-staging preservation.
deltas.tradeoff: Verification is more involved than checking files or running lint-staged once.

deltas.reason: Use a live commit only when it belongs to the task and stage only owned changes.
deltas.tradeoff: Removes unconditional committing as an installation proof.
